title: Room Reservations Deposit Handling Fee Limits by Refund Size
content:
**Finance table.** On a refund of money held on a Room Reservations reservation after a no-show, the fee charged depends on the size of the amount being refunded. When the money held less the amount kept is below the small-refund limit of 150.00, the fee charged is the lesser of the handling fee and the small-refund share, 10%, of that amount; when that amount is at least the large-refund limit of 1000.00, the fee charged is the lesser of the handling fee and the large-refund fee cap of 20.00; any other refund is charged the handling fee as it stands.

**Moment of the limit.** The limit acts on the handling fee as the fee schedule sets it, before any share of the fee is waived. The fee charged is the figure that any waiver of the fee then reduces, and what remains of it is taken off the money held less the amount kept.

**The amount tested.** The money held is every deposit payment collected for the reservation less every refund, forfeit and transfer of deposit money posted on it; the amount kept is every no-show charge on the reservation settled from money held, less every reversal posted against it; the amount tested is the money held less the amount kept, never below zero.

| Money held less the amount kept | Fee charged |
|---|---|
| below 150.00 | the lesser of the handling fee and 10% of that amount |
| 150.00 up to 999.99 | the handling fee as it stands |
| 1000.00 or more | the lesser of the handling fee and 20.00 |

**Cases (hypothetical handling fees).**

| Amount tested | Handling fee | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| 120.00 | 25.00 | lesser of 25.00 and 12.00: 12.00 |
| 149.99 | 45.00 | lesser of 45.00 and 14.999: 14.999 |
| 150.00 | 45.00 | 45.00 |
| 999.99 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| 1000.00 | 45.00 | lesser of 45.00 and 20.00: 20.00 |
| 1200.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

The fee charged is not rounded on its own; the cent is reached once, on the refund. In the 1000.00 row, for instance, the scheduled fee of 45.00 is limited to 20.00 first, and the 20.00 is the fee charged on which any waiver then acts.
